{"code": "from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency

# Check significance of site and severity imbalances

# Site
site_ct = pd.crosstab(data['arm'], data['site'])
chi2_site, p_site, dof_site, expected_site = chi2_contingency(site_ct)
print(f'Site chi2: {chi2_site:.4f}, p-value: {p_site:.4f}')

# Severity
severity_ct = pd.crosstab(data['arm'], data['severity'])
chi2_sev, p_sev, dof_sev, expected_sev = chi2_contingency(severity_ct)
print(f'Severity chi2: {chi2_sev:.4f}, p-value: {p_sev:.4f}')"}
